name: Peltastay
description: Close the fist around the centre grip and hold the plate at chest height to cover the throat.

name: Snug Centergrip
description: Take a straight blow flat on the plate with the forearm braced hard behind it.

name: Raised Knucklegrip
description: Turn the wrist a quarter and rap an incoming blade sideways before it reaches the body.

name: Sudden Bucklerredge
description: Punch the raised centre dome into the foe's chest with a short straight arm.

name: Nimble Dab
description: Advance one pace behind the shield while the rear foot stays light and the grip stays steady.

name: Armstrap Dash
description: Chop the lower rim down onto the foe's wrist or forearm as it reaches out.

name: Umbolid
description: Lock the knuckles around the bar and keep the plate level through a long drill.

name: Snug Edgeplate
description: Tuck the elbow to the ribs and let the plate cover the whole front of the shoulder.

name: Umbocowl
description: Flick the plate outward from the elbow to knock a thrust off its line.

name: Open Smallface
description: Snap the plate upward so the top rim raps the foe's chin or wrist.

name: Punchboss Wedge
description: Slide the plate along a falling blow so it glances away down the outside of the arm.

name: Tuckinwedge
description: Press the plate over the foe's weapon hand and pin it against his own body.

name: Light Nudge
description: Shuffle the lead foot forward and bring up the rear to close distance behind cover.

name: Ready Roundface
description: Raise the plate to brow height and watch the foe over its top edge.

name: Resting Lightrim
description: Drop the plate to the hip and shield the belly and thigh from a low cut.

name: Square Snapblock
description: Swing the plate sideways in a short hammering arc into the foe's ribs.

name: Ready Umbo
description: Turn the curved face under a cut so the blade skids off the dome and never bites.

name: Nudgepace
description: Step off the line of attack and bring the plate round to cover the new angle.

name: Gnawing Punchblock
description: Lead with the raised dome and punch straight at the foe's breastbone.

name: Descending Armstrap
description: Whip the outer rim across in a flat arc to rake the foe's forearm.

name: Smallface Bump
description: Scoop the rim upward from low to catch the foe's jaw as he leans in.

name: Ready Punchboss
description: Hold the dome toward the foe so cuts strike its curve and slide away.

name: Bucklerredge Wedge
description: Beat the rim against the foe's blade from the flat to knock the point off line.

name: Swaying Lightrim
description: Pivot on the lead foot and slide back out of reach with the plate still raised.

name: Peltahusk
description: Press the dome into the foe's sword arm to spoil his next cut.

name: Straight Tuckin
description: Rap the foe's guard twice in quick time with the rim so his weapon cannot rise.

name: Quiet Nudge
description: Step to the shield side of an oncoming cut and let the plate meet it at an angle.

name: Kept Roundface
description: Hold the plate canted outward so blows from the blade side slide past the shoulder.

name: Tight Knucklegrip
description: Cross the plate over the body and rap a thrust toward the foe's own far side.

name: Shifting Punchblock
description: Drag the rear heel back along the ground to widen distance by half a pace behind the plate.

name: Gnawing Edgeplate
description: Roll the plate edge-on and drive the shoulder behind it into the foe's front arm.

name: Sharp Umbo
description: Step back in on the foe's recovery and punch the plate face into his guard.

name: Lowered Centergrip
description: Open the plate toward the foe like a hand and sweep his thrust wide of the body.

name: Holding Smallface
description: Cock the wrist back and snap it forward to bat a cut away from the hip.

name: Peltacowl
description: Brush the plate upward along a falling cut so the edge glides over the shield arm.

name: Angled Edgeplate
description: Duck the head behind the plate and hold until the foe's swing has passed.

name: Blunt Parry
description: Slap the flat of the plate across the foe's guard hand right after a parry.

name: Peltanote
description: Watch the foe's shoulder and hip rather than the blade to read which way the next cut will come.

name: Parry Pace
description: Take a pace in with each parry so the foe's blade finds only the shield.

name: Snug Punchboss
description: Settle a thread of qi into the gripping hand so the plate holds firm under heavy blows.

name: Tight Centergrip
description: Spread qi thin across the face of the plate until it rings harder against a cutting edge.

name: Tuckinblow
description: Push a pulse of qi down the arm and into the dome as it strikes.

name: Targehusk
description: Rap the foe's blade with the rim while qi stiffens the wrist against the shock.

name: Shifting Umbo
description: Carry a breath of qi into the legs for one quick pace behind cover.

name: Parrystay
description: Shove the plate into the foe's weapon arm with qi settled behind it to break his rhythm.

name: Peltapause
description: Lock the wrist with a steady breath and hold the plate against a rain of cuts.

name: Snug Knucklegrip
description: Turn the plate on the wrist's pivot to meet a blade at the angle where it slides.

name: Umbostrike
description: Strike the foe's hand with the rim on the out-breath for a clean crack.

name: Roundface Wedge
description: Let the wrist give a little as the blow lands so the shock never reaches the shoulder.

name: Armstrap Cowl
description: Snap the plate back to centre after a deflection so the guard is closed again.

name: Peltalid
description: Circle the plate over the foe's blade and press it down so the sword cannot rise.

name: Swaying Dab
description: Match each pace to one breath so that the plate never wavers as the feet move.

name: Snug Lightrim
description: Draw the plate in to the chest and crouch behind it when the foe is within arm's length.

name: Planted Bucklerredge
description: Rap an inside cut aside with the rim before it can reach the ribs.

name: Targewedge
description: Roll the shoulder under the plate and let the blow spend itself on its curve.

name: Leaden Dab
description: Hammer the dome into the foe's belly from a hand's breadth away.

name: Nudgedrop
description: Chop the rim sideways into the foe's hip while he is stepping in.

name: Peltadodge
description: Crowd the foe with a short step that forces his blade to turn inward past its reach.

name: Locking Punchblock
description: Wedge the plate against the foe's sword elbow to lock the swing short.

name: Backward Punchblock
description: Back away pace by pace without ever letting the plate leave the line of the foe's blade.

name: Folded Armstrap
description: Hold the breath a moment and brace the plate before a heavy blow arrives.

name: Parrydrop
description: Release the breath into a rim strike across the foe's weapon wrist.

name: Knucklegrip Stay
description: Draw qi slowly along the arm in time with one long inhale while the plate stays still.

name: Umbowedge
description: Pulse qi into the wrist for a single hard parry against a fast cut.

name: Easing Smallface
description: Settle a breath into the legs and take one steady pace that does not disturb the guard.

name: Peltagauge
description: Listen to the ring of the plate under a blow to judge the weight behind the foe's cut.

name: Tuckincowl
description: Shove the plate forward on the closing exhale to knock the foe's arm off his line.

name: Ready Centergrip
description: Flick the plate from the elbow to bat a quick thrust off line.

name: Punchboss Stay
description: Tap the rim against the foe's blade from the side to beat it out of true.

name: Dabhit
description: Snap the plate edge across the foe's knuckles as they close on the hilt.

name: Edgeplate Pause
description: Rap once and bring the plate straight back to centre ready for the next blow.

name: Stepping Bucklerredge
description: Slide away on light feet as the plate raps the foe's blade clear.

name: Quick Umbo
description: Poke the dome sharply into the foe's wrist to make him loosen his grip.
